service.description: The cards of a contact book for CardDAV: each current member the user may see, by its name (davName, else partyId.vcf), with an entity tag over the rows its vCard is made of (the party, person or organization, contact mechanisms, relationships, the book membership), and the book's ctag; or, for a projected collection, the cards of partyIdList (not disabled), named partyId.vcf, with collectionId in its ctag. No access check: the callers check the book or the projection's owner.

parameter.name: partyIdList
parameter.description: A projected collection's parties, in place of a book

service.description: What a projected address book's owner service answers (ContactProjection.ownerServiceName), as the user: admitted, whether the user sees the collection at all; and without checkOnly the parties whose cards it holds (partyIdList). The owner decides what each user sees; the projection kind adds nothing to it.

A projected address book's cards (collectionId projected-{projectionId}, its ContactProjection not disabled) for the user: the cards of the parties its owner service answers (none when it does not admit the user), as get#ContactObjectTags names and tags them, and the collection's ctag; admitted false for a user the owner does not admit or an unknown projection. A failure of the owner is logged and answers nothing.

The CardDAV address books of the user: each contact book the user may view, read only when it is shared (a personal book is the user's own to change); and each projected address book whose owner admits the user (projected-{projectionId}, read only; impl-sales P5). With collectionId only that one.
The cards of an address book, by name (objectNameList) or all, with their vCard 3.0 text (withData): the text export#Contacts writes for the party, with the UID the client gave the card.

Store a card a CardDAV client wrote in a personal book: a new card becomes a personal contact in the book (import#ContactRow, never matched to another party), a card at a known name replaces that contact's names and its emails, phones, addresses and websites; the card's UID and name are kept on its book row. status 403 for a shared book or a directory party, 412 when ifMatch or ifNoneMatch fails, 400 for text that is not one vCard.

A CardDAV client's delete in a personal book: the card leaves the book, and a personal contact in no other book of the user is deleted (delete#Contact). status 403 for a shared book, 404 when the name is not there, 412 when ifMatch fails.
